studentTasks.noHistory: Your finished tasks will appear here.
studentTasks.listFailed: Your tasks could not be loaded. Try again, or ask your teacher for help.
studentTasks.unavailable: This task is unavailable. Ask your teacher to check your account and task.

studentTasks.learnerOnly: Open this page with the learner account your teacher assigned. An account name alone does not identify a learner.
studentTasks.setupTitle: Set up a learner account first
studentTasks.setupHint: This is an adult preview. Enable sign-in and create a learner account before sending a task. No learner answers can be submitted here.
studentTasks.reviewTitle: Ready to send to your teacher?
studentTasks.reviewHint: It is okay to need help. Your teacher will see your answers and the questions you could not do yet.
studentTasks.doneHint: You have finished this task. Your teacher will look at it with you.
studentTasks.revokedHint: Your teacher stopped this task. Your local writing is kept; ask your teacher what to do next.
studentTasks.serverSaved: Answers saved. You can come back later.
studentTasks.saveFailed: Your answer is still here. Try saving again, or ask your teacher for help.
studentTasks.submitFailed: We have not confirmed that your teacher received this. Your answers are kept. Try again with the same answers.
studentTasks.changed: This task was updated elsewhere. Your writing is kept. Ask your teacher to help compare it before reloading.
studentTasks.reloadHint: Reloading replaces the answers shown here with the saved answers. Download a copy first if you need to keep both.
studentTasks.localAvailable: Writing from this device is available
studentTasks.localFailed: This device could not keep a backup. Your writing is still here. Save to your teacher or download a copy before leaving.
studentTasks.localConflict: Another window changed this device's copy. Your writing is kept here. Download it and ask your teacher for help.
studentTasks.localInvalid: This device's copy could not be restored. It has been kept so you can download it and ask your teacher for help.
studentTasks.localClearFailed: Your answers were saved, but this device's backup could not be cleared. Try clearing the backup; you do not need to submit again.
studentTasks.unansweredHint: This question is still unanswered. You can write an answer or choose “I don't know yet”.
teacherTasks.hint: Send this saved practice version to a real student account. Report labels and student cases do not select an account.
teacherTasks.recipientHint: Check the username and account ID before sending.
teacherTasks.recipientUnavailable: This account cannot currently receive practice.
teacherTasks.noRecipients: No eligible student accounts are available yet.
teacherTasks.previewHint: Review the title, instructions, questions and every optional hint intended for the student. Students open hints one at a time. Reference answers, marking guidance and diagnostic notes are excluded.
teacherTasks.privacyHint: Check titles, instructions, question text and hints for names, private details or answers you may have written into them.
teacherTasks.reviewed: I have checked the selected account and all student-visible content.
teacherTasks.published: The server has confirmed this publishing record. Check its current status in the issued-task list.
teacherTasks.failed: The request did not finish. Your input is retained; retrying unchanged uses the same publishing identity.
teacherTasks.loadFailed: Student-task setup could not be loaded. The preview remains available.
teacherTasks.authRequired: Student delivery needs multi-user authentication and a student account. An administrator can configure these before publishing; the preview is available now.

teacherTasks.sourceBlocked: Save and confirm the current source and save these practice questions before publishing.

teacherTasks.invalidRecipient: Select an account that can receive practice.
teacherTasks.reviewRequired: Check the recipient and student-visible content before publishing.
teacherTasks.listHint: Each task keeps the source version and recipient chosen when it was issued. Unsubmitted work is not a final answer.
teacherTasks.listFailed: Issued tasks could not be loaded. Existing rows are retained.
teacherTasks.noTasks: No student tasks have been issued from this practice yet.
teacherTasks.detailFailed: The saved task could not be loaded. Retry without changing the source version.
teacherTasks.readOnly: This is a read-only record. Final student answers stay separate from teacher-recorded practice responses and grades.
teacherTasks.notSubmitted: The student has not submitted final answers. Draft work is not shown as a completed submission.
teacherTasks.finalAnswers: Final answers submitted by the student
teacherTasks.revokeHint: The student will no longer be able to submit this task. The issued content and any final answers remain in the history.
teacherTasks.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for revoking this task.
teacherTasks.revoked: Task revoked. Its content and submission history are retained.
teacherTasks.revokeFailed: The task could not be revoked. Your reason is retained; refresh the saved task if it changed.
teacherTasks.revokeChanged: The saved task needs to be checked again. Recheck its current version, then explicitly confirm revocation.
teacherTasks.cleanupPending: Publication is confirmed. Clearing the local publishing draft…
teacherTasks.sourceCheckFailed: The saved source could not be verified. Your input is retained. Retry verification before publishing.
teacherTasks.invalidAcknowledgement: The returned task does not match this publishing request. Keep the input and retry the same request.
teacherTasks.cleanupFailed: The server has confirmed publication, but the local publishing draft could not be cleared. Retry local cleanup; this will not publish again.
teacherTasks.clearFailed: The local publishing draft could not be cleared. Your input is retained.
teacherTasks.restored: Publishing input restored. Recheck the account and content after the saved source is verified; nothing has been published automatically.
teacherTasks.unsupportedIdentity: Student delivery is unavailable with the current identity service. An administrator can review the supported multi-user setup; this page will not change authentication settings.
teacherTasks.receiptRecovered: The publishing record was found ({{status}}). No new task was issued.
teacherTasks.receiptUnconfirmed: The publishing receipt could not be confirmed. Keep this input and identity; retry the check or publish the unchanged request when the source is ready.
teacherTasks.draftSourceVersion: This publishing draft uses practice version {{draft}}; the selected saved practice is version {{current}}. Clear this publishing form explicitly to use the selected version.

studentTaskVoice.preparingSpeech: Getting the question ready to read…
studentTaskVoice.localVoiceUnavailable: This device has no matching local reading voice. You can read the question instead.
studentTaskVoice.speechUnavailable: This question cannot be read aloud in full right now. You can read the text instead.
studentTaskVoice.speechFailed: The question could not be read aloud. Its text is still here; you can try again.
studentTaskVoice.recordHint: Recording starts when you tap. You have up to 25 seconds. Check the words before adding them; your existing answer stays.
studentTaskVoice.inputUnavailable: Your teacher has not enabled spoken answers. You can keep typing.
studentTaskVoice.transcriptionUnavailabl: Spoken answers are unavailable right now. You can type or ask your teacher for help.
studentTaskVoice.deviceUnsupported: Recording is unavailable on this device. You can keep typing.
studentTaskVoice.permissionDenied: Microphone permission was not granted. Your writing is still here; you can keep typing.
studentTaskVoice.prepareFailed: This recording could not be processed. Try saying it again, or type your answer.
studentTaskVoice.noSpeech: No clear speech was recognized. Try saying it again, or type your answer.
studentTaskVoice.recordFailed: The recording did not finish. Your writing is still here; you can try again.
studentTaskVoice.recordTooLarge: This recording is too long. Try a shorter answer, or keep typing.
studentTaskVoice.candidateHint: You can correct these words before adding them to your answer.
studentTaskVoice.lengthLimit: Your answer can have up to 6,000 characters. Shorten or edit these words before adding them.
studentTaskVoice.emptyCandidate: Write the words you want to add, or choose not to use this recording.
studentTaskVoice.readinessFailed: Voice features could not be checked. You can still type your answer.
studentTaskVoice.stale: The task has changed. This recording will not be added to another question. Keep your writing and ask your teacher for help.
studentTaskVoice.candidateRestored: Words awaiting your review are kept on this device. They have not been added to your answer.
teacherTaskHints.editorHint: Prepare up to three hints per question. The student opens them one at a time. Start with a way to think, then a small starting action; avoid giving the answer directly.
teacherTaskHints.templateHint: For example: first ask what information to compare; next suggest one sketch or first step; finally suggest one check. These are writing prompts, not ready-made hints for this question.
teacherTaskHints.empty: Write this hint, or remove the empty step before checking the preview.
teacherTaskHints.invalid: Use up to three nonempty hints per saved question, each within 600 characters of valid text.
teacherTaskHints.previewTitle: Hints the student may open (all shown here for teacher review)
teacherTaskHints.historyHint: Opening a hint does not show understanding. No unlock record does not prove that the student worked independently.
teacherTaskHints.noPlan: No step-by-step hints were included when this task was issued.
teacherTaskHints.currentUsage: These are the current hint unlock records. Unsubmitted answer text is not included.
teacherTaskHints.finalUsage: These hint unlock records were fixed when the final answers were submitted.
teacherTaskHints.legacyUsage: This older submission has no hint-use record. Do not interpret that as no hints used or independent work.
studentTaskHints.title: Teacher's hints
studentTaskHints.usageNote: Your teacher can see which hints were unlocked.
studentTaskHints.finished: These are all the hints. If you are still stuck, you can choose “I don't know yet”.
studentTaskHints.unavailable: Hints are unavailable right now. Your answer is still here; you can keep writing or ask your teacher for help.
studentTaskHints.retryHint: We could not confirm whether the hint opened. Check the saved hints, or retry the same request. Your answer is unchanged.
studentTaskHints.recovered: Your saved hints were found. No extra hint was opened.
studentTaskHints.changed: The saved hints changed in another window. Check the hints shown here before opening another.
studentTaskHints.voiceBlocked: Finish checking or cancel your recording before opening another hint.
caseTaskReviews.title: Formal task review evidence
caseTaskReviews.hint: These are explicitly linked versions of teacher reviews. They are separate from report observations and teacher-recorded practice responses.
caseTaskReviews.linkTitle: Link this review to a student case
caseTaskReviews.linkHint: Choose an existing case and explicitly check the learner account against its code and UUID. Similar names do not establish identity; no case or report link will be created automatically.
caseTaskReviews.boundUid: Account bound to these case links: {{id}}
caseTaskReviews.unbound: No learner account is bound to these evidence links yet.
caseTaskReviews.identityCheck: I have checked that this actual learner account and this case code/UUID refer to the same student.
caseTaskReviews.removalCheck: I confirm that only the selected evidence links will be removed from this case.
caseTaskReviews.boundOther: This case is bound to another learner account, or its identity cannot be verified. Open the case and check its existing links before changing the binding. Nothing has been removed automatically.
caseTaskReviews.missingPin: The case does not contain this exact source report version. Open the case, explicitly add and save that report version, then return and refresh.
caseTaskReviews.loadFailed: The saved evidence could not be read. Your local input is retained.
caseTaskReviews.listFailed: Student cases could not be listed. Retry without changing the current draft.
caseTaskReviews.empty: No formal task review has been associated with this case.
caseTaskReviews.invalid: Select one to three questions and keep each case note within 2,000 characters.
caseTaskReviews.limit: This case already has 20 submission references. Remove an existing reference before adding another.
caseTaskReviews.staleDraft: This draft uses another saved review, case or overlay version. It has been retained. Retry an unchanged request if its outcome is unknown, or explicitly clear it before starting again.
caseTaskReviews.saveFailed: The association was not confirmed. Your input and request ID are retained for an unchanged retry.
caseTaskReviews.saved: The server has confirmed this association change. Current evidence is read separately.
caseTaskReviews.cleanupFailed: The server has confirmed the change, but the local draft could not be cleared. Retry local cleanup; it will not save again.
caseTaskReviews.clearFailed: The local association draft could not be cleared. Your input is retained.
caseTaskReviews.replaceHint: Switching cases or reloading will discard this local association request. Saved tasks, reviews and case history stay in place.
caseTaskReviews.focusHint: Groups use the saved practice subject and knowledge-point label. Counts refer to distinct submitted questions in current valid links, not a mastery score.
caseTaskReviews.helpHint: Asking for help is an additional fact and may overlap the assessment categories. Opening a hint is not evidence of understanding.
caseTaskReviews.source.report_unlinked: Source report version is no longer linked
caseTaskReviews.excluded: This reference is retained for audit and excluded from current concern counts. No replacement version has been adopted automatically.
caseTaskReviews.hintsUnknown: This older submission has no hint-use record. That does not prove independent work.
caseTaskReviews.noHints: No hint unlock was recorded for this submission. This alone does not establish independence or understanding.
caseTaskReviews.unavailableQuestions: The exact source questions cannot currently be read. No content from a different version has been substituted.
caseTaskReviews.remove: Remove this evidence reference from the case
caseTaskReviews.archived: The case is archived. Existing references can be removed; adding or editing references requires an active case.
caseTaskReviews.readonlyVersion: This panel uses the saved case version. Unsaved edits above do not change the evidence.
caseTaskReviews.pendingChild: Finish or clear the evidence-association draft before saving another case version.
teacherTaskReviews.title: Review submitted work
teacherTaskReviews.subtitle: Save your assessment as a separate version. The learner's submitted answers stay unchanged.
teacherTaskReviews.loading: Checking the original submission and saved assessment…
teacherTaskReviews.sourceFailed: The original submission or assessment could not be checked. Local edits are kept; try again before saving.
teacherTaskReviews.invalidSource: The assessment does not match this exact submission. Keep your local edits and reload the original record.
teacherTaskReviews.noSubmission: This task has no final submission yet. An assessment can only be saved after the learner submits.
teacherTaskReviews.originalHint: Submitted text, help status and hint records are read-only. Your assessment below is separate.
teacherTaskReviews.question: Question
teacherTaskReviews.hintUnknown: Hint usage was not recorded for this older submission.
teacherTaskReviews.noHintUsed: No hint was unlocked for this question.
teacherTaskReviews.hintUsed: Unlocked {{count}} hint(s); this does not show whether they were read or understood.
teacherTaskReviews.reasonHint: Optional for the first assessment; required when correcting or restoring an assessment.
teacherTaskReviews.blankUngraded: No actual answer text is available. Keep this question ungraded.
teacherTaskReviews.validation: Check the assessment fields and text limits. A correction needs a reason; a question without answer text must stay ungraded.
teacherTaskReviews.savedNewer: Your version {{n}} was saved, and a newer assessment exists. Your view is kept until you explicitly reload.
teacherTaskReviews.savedLocalPending: The assessment was saved, but its local backup could not be cleared. Retry cleanup; do not save another copy.
teacherTaskReviews.headUnverified: Your saved receipt is kept, but the latest assessment could not be checked. Check again before editing or linking a case.
teacherTaskReviews.pending: The save result is not confirmed. Your exact request and edits are kept; check its receipt or retry the same request.
teacherTaskReviews.receiptNotFound: No matching receipt was found yet. Your local edits are kept; you may retry the same request.
teacherTaskReviews.failed: The assessment could not be saved. Your local edits are kept.
teacherTaskReviews.conflict: A newer assessment version exists. Your edits are kept. Reload explicitly before starting another assessment.
teacherTaskReviews.replaceHint: This replaces local edits with the current saved assessment. Saved assessment history and the learner's answers remain available.
teacherTaskReviews.withdrawHint: A withdrawal adds a version and keeps the earlier assessments. It does not withdraw the learner's task or change the submitted answer.
teacherTaskReviews.historyEmpty: No assessment has been saved yet.
teacherTaskReviews.historyFailed: Assessment history could not be loaded. Your current edits are unchanged.
teacherTaskReviews.historyReadonly: This is a read-only historical version. It does not replace your current editor.
teacherTaskReviews.linkerPending: Finish or clear the case-link draft before changing, withdrawing or reloading the assessment.
teacherTaskReviews.linkerSourceChanged: The assessment has a newer version. The case-link draft still refers to its original version; clear it before switching sources.
teacherTaskReviews.teacherOnly: Teacher-only assessment. Saving does not change the learner's answer or automatically publish feedback to the learner.
caseTaskReviews.authRequired: Saving formal review associations requires multi-user authentication and an administrator account with a real staff ID. This preview is read-only and does not change authentication settings.
teacherTaskReviews.authRequired: Enable sign-in and use an administrator account to save or withdraw assessments. Existing records are read-only here.
caseTaskReviews.stopRequest: Stop waiting and keep this request
